`column_validation`



## Functions

| [column_validation](#sudoku_validation.column_validation.column_validation) | Validate the columns of a Sudoku board. |

### column_validation { #sudoku_validation.column_validation.column_validation }

```python
column_validation.column_validation(board)
```

Validate the columns of a Sudoku board.

This function checks that each column in the Sudoku board contains
the digits 1-9 exactly once, with no duplicates. 

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                | Description                                                                           | Default    |
|--------|---------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| board  | list of list of int | A 9x9 grid representing a Sudoku board. Each cell should contain an integer from 1-9. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                               |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | bool   | True if all columns are valid (no duplicate digits 1-9), False otherwise. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                                  |
|--------|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If the board is not a 9x9 grid or if any of the cells contain a value outside the range 1-9. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> board = [
...     [4, 3, 0, 0, 7, 0, 0, 0, 0],
...     [6, 0, 0, 1, 9, 5, 0, 0, 0],
...     [0, 9, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0],
...     [8, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0, 0, 0, 3],
...     [4, 0, 0, 8, 0, 3, 0, 0, 1],
...     [7, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 6],
...     [0, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 8, 0],
...     [0, 0, 0, 4, 1, 9, 0, 0, 5],
...     [0, 0, 0, 0, 8, 0, 0, 7, 9]
... ]
>>> column_validation(board)
False
```

```python
>>> board = [
...     [3, 2, 6, 9, 7, 4, 8, 1, 5],
...     [8, 1, 9, 3, 5, 6, 4, 7, 2],
...     [5, 4, 7, 2, 1, 8, 9, 6, 3],
...     [9, 5, 2, 7, 3, 1, 6, 4, 8],
...     [1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 5, 2, 7],
...     [6, 7, 8, 4, 2, 5, 1, 3, 9],
...     [7, 6, 1, 8, 9, 3, 2, 5, 4],
...     [2, 9, 5, 1, 4, 7, 3, 8, 6],
...     [4, 8, 3, 5, 6, 2, 7, 9, 1]
... ]
>>> column_validation(board)
True
```
